name: Wall Mount Soap Dispenser
subtitle: 350ml dispenser with sponge holder
description: A 350ml liquid soap dispenser with a built-in sponge holder, transparent reservoir, and easy-press pump. The removable adhesive bracket supports wall mounting, while the compact design can also be used freestanding on a kitchen or bathroom counter.
story: Keeping soap and a sponge in one unit can reduce loose items around the sink. The top holder provides a dedicated place for a sponge or scrubber, while the transparent reservoir lets you check the remaining liquid before refilling. It can be mounted using the removable adhesive bracket or placed directly on a countertop. The listed silicone valve is intended to reduce dripping after dispensing. Its 350ml capacity offers a compact reservoir size without requiring a large dispenser body.

specs.dimensions: 11 cm W × 8 cm D × 16 cm H

shipping: Estimated delivery in around 7 days. Delivery may arrive earlier or take longer depending on your destination and carrier.
